study_tips: Use active recall: test yourself instead of re-reading notes.
Space repetition over days beats one long cram session.
Teach a topic to a friend to find the gaps in your understanding.
Do the hardest subject first when willpower is highest.
Mock exams under timed conditions predict real performance best.
essay_tips: Show, don't tell: use a specific story that reveals character.
Open with a vivid moment, not a generic statement.
Connect your activities to a genuine, evolving interest.
Keep the 'why this university' concrete and specific.
Edit for one idea per paragraph and a strong closing.
competition_tips: Pick 1-2 Olympiads aligned with your strongest subject.
Past papers are the best predictor — solve 5+ years.
Form a study group; explaining sharpens your own grasp.
Track deadlines in a single calendar to avoid clashes.
A medal helps, but sustained effort matters more than one win.
